Tax Free & Duty Free - Fast Free U.S. Shipping - Free Returns...

We are an authorized U.S. JPTR FX pedals dealer, and $159 is your absolute final/total here year-round, for this brand new JPTR FX Super Weirdo fuzz and modulation pedal (with box, etc.). Handmade in Germany!

Note: JPTR FX pedals are from Wilhelmshaven Germany, and feature a gnarly modern industrial design with some actual scratches, scrapes, and scuffs, for that recycled metal look and feel. Hence their phrase... UGLIEST SOUND DEVICES!

The JPTR FX Super Weirdo pedal is a Pulse Width Modulator Fuzz, that will BLOW YOUR MIND! Create UNBELIEVABLE soundscapes, with its advanced, time-based modulation effect. It adds mesmerizing movement and texture to your sound, giving you the power to craft everything from subtle, shimmering noise, to full-blown warbles and sweeps. With the Glitch footswitch, and an expression pedal input (expression pedal sold separately), you'll have an arsenal of tools at your fingertips to create truly OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD sounds.


This groundbreaking pedal is great for noise rock, and avant-garde guitarists, looking for innovative ways to be creative. Say goodbye to boring, earthling fuzz pedals, and embrace the genre-defying Super Weirdo!

POWER SUPPLY (sold separately):
This pedal does not use batteries, it uses a 9 Volt DC, center negative, 2.1mm power supply (just like most all guitar pedals use). Current draw is <50 mA. Use of any power supply higher than 9 Volt DC can damage the pedal.
